text: Yes, Hansen recorded tree-cover loss within the property in 2021. The total area of tree-cover loss was approximately 81.3 hectares, which represents about 2.23% of the asset's total area. This loss was corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference, which agreed on 98% of the event area. The loss occurred in a planted forest context, primarily affecting Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda species. However, it's important to note that this data does not specify the cause of the loss or whether it was legal or authorized.
